differences: Each immutable profile includes exact changed inputs, configured/effective states, account authority and declared capabilities. Literal per-case input deltas and named comparison overrides are retained in protection-cases.json; outcomes are not derived from production.

targetServiceAccountMappings.scope: All WPROT05 cases and account-type-selection subfixtures; same-domain distinct protected report service, never client-local loopback
targetServiceAccountMappings.authorization: Server-owned verified PAC facts and opaque local context; independent READ_DATA mask1 ACL; no native token dump or complete group expansion claim

directoryRecordInputs.scope: WPROT04 direct account policy; WPROT05 target service policy
directoryRecordInputs.assignedSilo: The actual account assigned-silo pointer is present only when profile.assignedSilo is true
directoryRecordInputs.siloMembers: The independently stored member SID array contains that account SID only when profile.siloMember is true
directoryRecordInputs.selection: Matching assignment AND membership selects the account-type silo slot; otherwise direct assignment. Silo enforcement comes from the selected silo, not the direct policy.
directoryRecordInputs.domainRid500: Own AD account AS policy exception only; never local SAM RID500, target-service policy or resource ACL exemption
